CLI Reference¶

The widget command manages widgets. Press Ctrl+C to abort.

Warning

Running widget purge deletes all data.

Installation

$ pip install widget
$ widget --version

Usage

widget create --name "demo" --size 3
widget list | grep demo

Configuration lives in ~/.widgetrc:

{
  "color": "blue",
  "retries": 3
}

Options

OptionDefaultDescription
--namenoneWidget name (required).
--size1Size, from 1 to 10.
Larger is slower.
--force, -ffalseOverwrite existing widgets.

Exit codes

0
Success.
2
Invalid usage. See Usage.

API

Call widget.create() from Python:

import widget
w = widget.create(name="demo")  # returns a Widget
print(w.size * 2)

See also: Changelog, GitHub.
